facts.text: Park Hyatt Shanghai occupies the 79th to the 93rd floors of the Shanghai World Financial Centre.
facts.excerpt: Spanning the 79th to the 93rd floors of the Shanghai World Financial Centre (SWFC)

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the Lujiazui business district.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Shanghai's prime location in the heart of the Lujiazui business district

facts.text: The hotel was designed by New York-based designer Tony Chi as a modern-Chinese residence.
facts.excerpt: Designed by award-winning New York-based designer Tony Chi, Park Hyatt Shanghai was conceived as a sophisticated modern-Chinese residence.

facts.text: Every room has views of either the Huangpu River or the Shanghai cityscape.
facts.excerpt: Every room features views of either the Huangpu River or the Shanghai cityscape.

facts.text: Rooms have a separate powder room with a Washlet and a bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and deep soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: a separate powder room for privacy with a Washlet, and a deluxe bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and deep soaking tub

facts.text: Every guest room has floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Every guest room features floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking panoramic views of the Shanghai skyline

facts.text: An infinity pool and heated hot tub are on level 85.
facts.excerpt: signature infinity pool and heated hot tub on level 85

facts.text: The spa offers treatments focused on health, wellbeing and harmonious balance.
facts.excerpt: Spa provides a selection of treatments that focus on the concept of health, wellbeing and harmonious balance

facts.text: In-house guests can join a complimentary Morning Sound Bowl Floating Experience at Water's Edge on level 85 on Thursdays and Sundays, with reservations required.
facts.excerpt: complimentary Morning Sound Bowl Floating Experience from 6:30–7:30 a.m. every Thursday and Sunday at Water's Edge on level 85, exclusively for in-house guests. Reservations are required.

facts.text: Park Salon on level 86 is open exclusively to in-house guests and offers free-flow champagne and premium wines.
facts.excerpt: Perched on Level 86, Park Salon is a perfect space for business engagements and leisurely staycations. Open exclusively for in-house guests, this intimate space features all-day champagne and premium wines free-flow

facts.text: Dining Room on level 87 is a contemporary Chinese restaurant serving modern Shanghainese, Zhejiang and Jiangsu cuisines.
facts.excerpt: Located on Level 87, Dining Room is a contemporary Chinese restaurant that celebrates modern Shanghainese, Zhejiang and Jiangsu cuisines

facts.text: Dining Room was named a Selected Restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Shanghai and received One Diamond in the 2026 Black Pearl Restaurant Guide.
facts.excerpt: Dining Room has been awarded the 2026 Black Pearl Restaurant Guide – One Diamond and the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Shanghai "Selected Restaurant."

facts.text: 100 Century Avenue Steakhouse serves a grill menu of prime beef, market-fresh seafood and premium poultry.
facts.excerpt: presenting a grill menu that features a wide selection of prime beef, market-fresh seafood, and premium poultry

facts.text: 100 Century Avenue Bar is on level 91.
facts.excerpt: Located on level 91, 100 Century Avenue Bar offers guests a comfortable, intimate setting for casual drinks.

facts.text: 100 Century Avenue Cantonese serves traditional dim sum on the east side of Level 91.
facts.excerpt: 100 Century Avenue Cantonese brings you traditional dim sum, steamed and authentic hot dishes on the east side of Level 91

facts.text: Tea on 87 is an afternoon tea served course by course in the Living Room on the 87th floor.
facts.excerpt: Served in the Living Room on the 87th floor, Tea on 87 features a curated selection of sweet and savory creations inspired by seasonal fruits and premium ingredients. Thoughtfully presented in an interactive course-by-course sharing format

facts.text: The Living Room on level 87 is a residential-style venue that encloses the reception area.
facts.excerpt: Living Room is a residential-style venue located on level 87, enclosing the reception area.

facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Room service is available 24 hours a day at the Park Hyatt Shanghai

facts.text: The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Lujiazui Metro Station.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Shanghai is located a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Lujiazui Station.

facts.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

facts.text: Hotel parking spaces are limited and reserved for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Shanghai offers limited parking spaces exclusively for in-house guests

facts.text: Limousine transfers from the airports require advance reservation.
facts.excerpt: Advance reservation is required.

facts.text: The art includes hundreds of ceramics by Liu Jianhua hanging from the ceiling of 100 Century Avenue.
facts.excerpt: hundreds of kitsch ceramics by Liu Jianhua hanging from the ceiling of 100 Century Avenue

facts.text: Owner Minoru Mori, who built Tokyo's Roppongi Hills complex, influenced the hotel's art.
facts.excerpt: Owner Minoru Mori, who built Toyko's groundbreaking Roppongi Hills complex, influenced the art here

facts.text: The hotel has 173 guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: the number of guest rooms has been limited to 173

facts.text: The hotel has 174 rooms.
facts.excerpt: All 174 generous-sized rooms
